title: Detection of plasmid-mediated colistin-resistant and carbapenem-resistant genes by multiplex PCR
author: Hatrongjit, Kerdsin, et al.
materials: •Sodium dodecyl sulfate (SDS) (Sigma-Aldrich, USA or equivalent)•Sodium hydroxide (Sigma-Aldrich, USA or equivalent)

The multiplex PCR assay was performed in 15-μl reaction mixtures, containing 2 μl of template, 1.5 μl of deionized water, 1X JumpStart™ REDTaq® ReadyMix™ PCR Reaction Mix (Sigma–Aldrich, USA) and 0.53 μM of each primer (Table 1). The following PCR thermal profile was used: initial activation of DNA polymerase at 95 °C for 3 min; 30 cycles of denaturation at 95 °C for 30 s, primer annealing at 56 °C for 30 s and extension at 72 °C for 45 s, and a final extension at 72 °C for 5 min. The PCR products were analyzed using gel electrophoresis for 30 min on 2% agarose gels in 0.5X TBE buffer. The gels were stained with ethidium bromide and visualized under ultraviolet light (GeneGenius Bioimaging System, SynGene). The sizes of the PCR products were determined by comparison with a molecular-sized standard (GeneRuler™ 100 bp Plus DNA ladder, Thermo Fisher Scientific).

steps.title: Culture bacteria on selective agar
steps.instruction: Streak the bacterial isolate onto blood agar or MacConkey agar and incubate at 37 °C for 18–24 hours.

steps.title: Extract genomic DNA by heat lysis
steps.instruction: Pick one or two colonies from the overnight plate, suspend them in 30 µl lysis buffer (0.25 % vol/vol sodium dodecyl sulfate and 0.05 M NaOH), heat at 95 °C for 15 min, add 200 µl sterile distilled water, mix, and store the lysate at –20 °C until PCR.

substeps.instruction: Prepare lysis buffer containing 0.25 % SDS (vol/vol) and 0.05 M NaOH.
Add 30 µl of lysis buffer to the selected colonies.
Heat the mixture at 95 °C for 15 minutes.
Add 200 µl sterile distilled water to the lysate.
Mix gently and store the DNA solution at –20 °C.

steps.title: Prepare multiplex PCR master mix
steps.instruction: In a sterile PCR tube combine the following to a final volume of 15 µl: 1.5 µl deionized water, 7.5 µl 1X JumpStart™ REDTaq® ReadyMix™, 0.5 µl of each primer (IMP‑F, IMP‑R, OXA‑48‑F, OXA‑48‑R, NDM‑F, NDM‑R, KPC‑F, KPC‑R, MCR1‑F, MCR1‑R) to give a final primer concentration of 0.53 µM, and 2 µl of the extracted DNA template.

substeps.instruction: Add 0.5 µl of each forward and reverse primer (final 0.53 µM each).
Mix gently and bring the total volume to 15 µl.

steps.title: Run PCR thermal cycling program
steps.instruction: Place the PCR tubes in a thermocycler and run: 95 °C for 3 min (initial activation); 30 cycles of 95 °C for 30 s, 56 °C for 30 s, 72 °C for 45 s; followed by a final extension at 72 °C for 5 min.

steps.title: Separate PCR products by agarose gel electrophoresis
steps.instruction: Prepare a 2 % agarose gel in 0.5 X TBE buffer, load the PCR products, run at appropriate voltage for 30 min, stain the gel with ethidium bromide, visualize bands under UV light using a GeneGenius Bioimaging System, and compare band sizes to a GeneRuler™ 100 bp Plus DNA ladder.

substeps.instruction: Make a 2 % agarose gel in 0.5 X TBE buffer.
Load each 15 µl PCR reaction (with loading dye) into wells.
Stain the gel with ethidium bromide.
Image the gel under UV illumination (GeneGenius Bioimaging System).
Determine amplicon sizes by comparison with the GeneRuler™ 100 bp Plus DNA ladder.
